title: Bayesian Gaussian Copula Endogeneity Correction
text: Package website: https://ashgreat.github.io/endogCopulaBayes/ endogCopulaBayes implements Bayesian Gaussian copula endogeneity correction Haschka (2025, Oxford Bulletin Economics Statistics). estimator handles endogenous regressor without instruments. models joint distribution regressors regression error Gaussian copula, draws every unknown quantity Metropolis-within-Gibbs MCMC sampler: regression coefficients, residual variance, copula correlation matrix, Dirichlet probability masses describing marginal distribution regressor. package builds endogCopula, supplies shared model parsing diagnostic helpers used across whole toolbox.

CDF regressor drawn sampler rather plugged , ties normal case binary regressor simply gets two probability masses. also nboots argument. Inference posterior, controlled iterations, burnin thin instead. Supplying cdf, ties nboots raises error. Exogeneity regressor bar imposed holding matching entries copula correlation matrix exactly zero. real output example , run iterations = 3000 keep fast. Use many iterations practice. default 102,000. summary(fit) adds posterior standard deviations, medians, 95 percent credible intervals coefficients, residual variance, endogeneity correlation:

title: Bayesian Gaussian copula endogeneity correction — CopRegBAYES
text: formula Two-part formula, y ~ endogenous | exogenous, everywhere else toolbox: factors, interactions, transformations -1 work, position term around | decides whether treated endogenous (gets copula term) exogenous. Every non-intercept column design matrix enters copula, four-level factor exogenous side contributes three columns two unique values . data data.frame holding variables formula. iterations Total number MCMC iterations. Defaults 102,000, setting used paper's simulations. burnin Number iterations discarded start chain. Defaults 2,000. thin Keep every thin-th iteration burn-. Defaults 100, together defaults leaves 1,000 draws. Draws thinned produced rather fact, retained iterates ever held memory. horseshoe TRUE (default), horseshoe prior placed every regression coefficient, including intercept. FALSE, coefficient instead gets independent \(N(0, \phi^2)\) prior \(\phi^2\) drawn conjugate Gibbs step inverse Gamma full conditional. prior.args list overriding hyperparameters, default paper's settings: , b inverse Gamma prior residual variance; Psi1, nu1 exogenous-regressor covariance block; Psi2, nu2 copula error-covariance block; a_e, b_e structural-error variance reparameterisation; M0, V0 regression--exogenous--error prior; a_phi, b_phi normal-prior variance used horseshoe = FALSE. start list overriding starting values (coefficients, sigma2, Sigma, lambda). defaults follow Web Appendix D paper: OLS coefficients residual variance, identity matrix Sigma, one draw Dir(1) distribution per regressor probability masses. subset optional logical index vector selecting rows data use, lm(). contrasts optional list passed model.matrix() coding factors. verbose TRUE, print starting message show text progress bar sampling. Defaults interactive(). cdf valid argument estimator: marginal CDF parameter drawn sampler rather plug-choice. Supplying raises error. ties valid argument estimator, reason cdf. Supplying raises error. nboots valid argument estimator: inference posterior rather bootstrap. Use iterations, burnin thin instead. Supplying raises error.

title: Identification and convergence checks for a copregbayes fit — validity.copregbayes
text: validity() CopRegBAYES fit reports two things . First, identification requirement model: copula correction identified nonnormality endogenous regressors, since normality \(E(e|z)\) linear copula separate regressor variation error variation; posterior endogeneity correlations (correlation endogenous regressor's normal score structural error) reported alongside, since Bayesian version expected degrade gracefully – concentrating near zero rather producing confident nonsense – identification weak. Second, convergence MCMC chain : Geweke's statistic, effective sample size lag-one autocorrelation, computed chain already , plus – request, since needs several chains dispersed starting values – Gelman-Rubin statistic, costs one run sampler per additional chain. print() result formats .

code: set.seed(1) n <- 60 x <- rnorm(n); z <- x + rnorm(n); y <- 1 + z + x + rnorm(n) fit <- CopRegBAYES(y ~ z | x, data = data.frame(y, z, x),                     iterations = 200, burnin = 50, thin = 5, verbose = FALSE) validity(fit) #>  #> Checks for the Bayesian copula correction #>  #> [1] Nonnormality of the endogenous regressors #>     Identification comes from the nonlinearity of E(e|z), which is #>     present only when z is nonnormal; under normality the copula cannot #>     tell regressor variation from error variation. #>   skewness ex.kurtosis    AD  CvM  KS p Yang ok Becker ok #> z   -0.691       0.741 0.451 0.06 0.812   FALSE     FALSE #>  #> [2] Posterior of the endogeneity correlations #>              P. Mean 2.5%    97.5%   P(rho > 0) #> rho(z*, xi*) -0.4564 -0.7113  0.1041  0.1000    #>     An interval covering zero says the data carry no evidence of #>     endogeneity, which is the honest reading; it is not a test decision. #>  #> [3] Convergence of the chain #>     Geweke compares the first tenth with the last half of the draws and #>     is a z statistic, so |Geweke| > 2 is a warning sign. ESS is the #>     effective number of independent draws behind 30 retained ones. #>                Geweke     ESS    AC(1) #> (Intercept)    4.5229  18.240  0.29615 #> z            -11.1126   5.897  0.76881 #> x             13.0992   5.391  0.66270 #> sigma2        -7.5163   5.991  0.58845 #> rho(z*, x*)   -0.9601 798.730 -0.06026 #> rho(z*, xi*)   7.1434   6.304  0.76326 #>     Acceptance rates: coefficients 0.835, sigma2 0.865 #>  #> [4] Gelman-Rubin was not computed #>     It needs several chains from dispersed starts, so it costs one #>     further run of the sampler per chain. Pass chains = TRUE, or a #>     number, to compute it. #>  #> Source: Haschka (2025), Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics

title: endogCopulaBayes 0.2.0
text: CopRegBayes() replaced CopRegBAYES(), ported rewritten reference implementation. takes two part formula used across toolbox, y ~ endogenous | exogenous, returns object class "copregbayes" coef(), vcov(), confint(), residuals(), fitted(), predict(), plot(), summary() validity() methods. diagnostics() replaced validity(), also reports chain convergence can compute Gelman-Rubin statistic request.

title: endogCopulaBayes 0.2.0
text: 0.1.0 sampler ported superseded revision reference code, differed current reference implementation four sampler blocks. coefficient step used plain symmetric random walk instead Hastings corrected IWLS proposal. variance step used inverse gamma independence proposal instead Laplace proposal. Exogeneity imposed zeroing entries unrestricted inverse Wishart draw rejecting, instead block recursive decomposition now holds zeros exactly. marginal transform used cumulative right endpoint instead cell midpoint. data seed two samplers produce different posteriors, 0.2.0 sampler one reproduces published reference 1e-12.
